name: BigCommerce API
tagline: REST and GraphQL APIs for headless and multi-channel BigCommerce storefronts
description: BigCommerce provides REST Catalog, Management, and GraphQL Storefront APIs so developers can manage products, orders, customers, checkout, and storefront content for BigCommerce merchants. Access is store-scoped via OAuth or store API credentials.

auth.details: Store-scoped OAuth access token or API account credentials; typically X-Auth-Token header with client ID for REST

use_cases: list catalog products for a BigCommerce store
create or update product SKUs and prices
fetch orders and update fulfillment status
build a headless storefront with GraphQL Storefront API
